mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a cool 60 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight, and keep an eye out for the ISS rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb at 3:24 AM, traveling toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City is currently hiring for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, with applications due September 20. Additionally, the City Council has approved new utility rates to keep our sewer and stormwater services self-supporting, noting that average residential bills will see a modest increase to cover infrastructure and equipment costs.

There is plenty to do, with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Girls Try Hockey both happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a full week of community fun like Hop Haus Trivia and the Downtown Farmer's Market starting on Tuesday.
On Friday, August 15, a 29-year-old Verona man was arrested for a second offence O W I and cited for having open intoxicants in his vehicle.
Today's flavor is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM to serve you.
